questions.subject: Financial Administration and Office Procedure
questions.question_english: Identify the correct statement regarding the responsibility for the quality of goods procured through GeM.
options_english: The Principal Accounts Office holds sole financial and technical responsibility for verifying quality of goods.
GeM administration holds sole legal and operational responsibility for the physical quality of delivered goods.
The State Government Finance Department guarantees the quality and specification of all goods listed on GeM.
Responsibility for quality, specifications, and timely delivery lies with the buyer.
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is option A. The Principal Accounts Office is responsible for the financial and technical verification of the quality of goods procured through GeM. This responsibility ensures that the goods meet the required standards and specifications before they are accepted. It is crucial for maintaining accountability in public procurement and ensuring that the government receives value for money in its purchases.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। प्रधान लेखा कार्यालय जेम के माध्यम से खरीदे गए सामान की गुणवत्ता की वित्तीय और तकनीकी जांच के लिए जिम्मेदार है। यह जिम्मेदारी सुनिश्चित करती है कि सामान स्वीकृति से पहले आवश्यक मानकों और विनिर्देशों को पूरा करता है। यह सार्वजनिक खरीद में जवाबदेही बनाए रखने और यह सुनिश्चित करने के लिए महत्वपूर्ण है कि सरकार अपनी खरीद में मूल्य प्राप्त करे।
questions.topic: Constitutional Provisions for PwBD EWS SC ST and Disadvantaged Groups
key_facts: The Principal Accounts Office verifies the quality of goods.
Accountability in public procurement is essential.
Printed answer key: (A) The Principal Accounts Office holds sole financial and technical responsibility for verifying quality of goods.

questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the general principles of financial propriety:
I. Expenditure should not be incurred for the benefit of a particular section of people unless a claim for the amount could be enforced in a Court of Law.
II. The expenditure must be in pursuance of a recognized policy or custom.
III. Allowances can be regulated to serve as an alternative source of extra income for employees.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
options_english: I and II
II and III
I and III
I, II and III
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is option B. Statements I and II are correct as they align with the principles of financial propriety, which emphasize that expenditures should be justified and based on established policies. Statement III is incorrect because allowances should not be used as a means to provide extra income, which could lead to misuse of public funds. Thus, the correct statements are I and II.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। बयान I और II सही हैं क्योंकि वे वित्तीय प्रावधानों के सिद्धांतों के साथ मेल खाते हैं, जो यह जोर देते हैं कि व्यय को उचित ठहराया जाना चाहिए और स्थापित नीतियों के आधार पर होना चाहिए। बयान III गलत है क्योंकि भत्तों का उपयोग अतिरिक्त आय के स्रोत के रूप में नहीं किया जाना चाहिए, जो सार्वजनिक धन के दुरुपयोग की संभावना को जन्म दे सकता है। इसलिए, सही बयान I और II हैं।
questions.topic: Constitutional Provisions for PwBD EWS SC ST and Disadvantaged Groups
key_facts: Financial propriety principles ensure justified expenditures.
Public funds should not be misused for personal gain.
Printed answer key: (B) The expenditure must be in pursuance of a recognized policy or custom.

questions.question_english: Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R). Assertion (A): The procuring authority must ensure fair and equitable treatment of all eligible suppliers during the public buying process. Reason (R): Transparency and competition are essential to achieve the best value for money in public procurement. In light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below: (A) Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A) (B) Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A) (C) (A) is true but (R) is false (D) Both (A) and (R) are false.
options_english: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is true but (R) is false
Both (A) and (R) are false
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (B) because both statements are indeed true; however, the reason provided does not serve as a correct explanation for the assertion. While the procuring authority must ensure fair treatment, the assertion does not directly imply that transparency and competition are the only means to achieve this. The principles of fairness can also be upheld through other regulatory frameworks and ethical guidelines.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। क्योंकि दोनों कथन सत्य हैं; हालाँकि, दिया गया कारण असर्शन के लिए सही स्पष्टीकरण के रूप में कार्य नहीं करता है। जबकि खरीदने वाली प्राधिकरण को निष्पक्ष व्यवहार सुनिश्चित करना चाहिए, असर्शन यह नहीं कहता कि पारदर्शिता और प्रतिस्पर्धा ही इसको प्राप्त करने के एकमात्र साधन हैं। निष्पक्षता के सिद्धांत अन्य नियामक ढांचों और नैतिक दिशानिर्देशों के माध्यम से भी बनाए रखे जा सकते हैं।
questions.topic: Constitutional Provisions for PwBD EWS SC ST and Disadvantaged Groups
key_facts: Section 34 of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act of 2016 mandates fair treatment in procurement.
Printed answer key: (B) Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)

questions.question_english: Which specific rule under the General Financial Rules 2017 outlines the 'Standards of Financial Propriety'?
options_english: Rule 11
Rule 144
Rule 225
Rule 21
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is Rule 144, which outlines the 'Standards of Financial Propriety' in the General Financial Rules 2017. This rule emphasizes the need for financial prudence and accountability in public expenditure, ensuring that government officials act with the same diligence as a reasonable person would with their own finances. This principle is crucial for maintaining integrity and transparency in financial administration.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। नियम 144 सामान्य वित्तीय नियम 2017 में "वित्तीय शुद्धता के मानक" को रेखांकित करता है। यह नियम सार्वजनिक व्यय में वित्तीय विवेक और जवाबदेही की आवश्यकता पर जोर देता है, यह सुनिश्चित करता है कि सरकारी अधिकारी अपने वित्त के साथ एक सामान्य व्यक्ति की तरह ही सावधानी बरतें। यह सिद्धांत वित्तीय प्रशासन में ईमानदारी और पारदर्शिता बनाए रखने के लिए महत्वपूर्ण है।
questions.topic: Constitutional Provisions for PwBD EWS SC ST and Disadvantaged Groups
key_facts: General Financial Rules 2017 provide guidelines for financial propriety.
Rule 144 specifically addresses standards of financial prudence.
Printed answer key: (B) Rule 144

questions.question_english: What is the validity period of an Income and Asset Certificate issued for EWS reservation purposes?
options_english: Valid indefinitely until formally revoked
Valid for five consecutive financial years
Valid for the financial year of issue
Valid throughout the entire academic life of the student
questions.explanation_english: An Income and Asset Certificate issued for EWS reservation is valid strictly for the financial year in which it is issued. Since family income and property holdings fluctuate annually, applicants must obtain a fresh EWS certificate for each new financial year to claim reservation benefits in admissions or recruitment processes.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। आर्थिक और संपत्ति प्रमाणपत्र जो EWS आरक्षण के लिए जारी किया जाता है, वह केवल उसी वित्तीय वर्ष के लिए मान्य होता है जिसमें इसे जारी किया गया है। चूंकि परिवार की आय और संपत्ति की धारक वार्षिक रूप से बदलती हैं, आवेदकों को हर नए वित्तीय वर्ष के लिए आरक्षण लाभ प्राप्त करने के लिए एक नया EWS प्रमाणपत्र प्राप्त करना आवश्यक है।
questions.topic: Constitutional Provisions for PwBD EWS SC ST and Disadvantaged Groups
key_facts: Income and Asset Certificate is valid for the financial year of issue.
Applicants must renew the certificate annually.
Printed answer key: (c) Valid for the financial year of issue.
